python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, re
pat=re.compile(r'(?i)overlap')
seen=set(); n=0
for l in open('diffs.jsonl'):
    d=json.loads(l)
    t='\n'.join(d['added'])
    for m in pat.finditer(t):
        s=t[max(0,m.start()-250):m.end()+200].replace('\n',' | ')
        if s[:80] in seen: continue
        seen.add(s[:80]); n+=1
        if n<=14: print(d['line'],d['time'][:16],d['label'][:22],'::',s); print()
print('distinct',n)
pat2=re.compile(r'(?i)\bhonest|\bcheat|collu|allowed to|permitted|the rules|unfair|prohibit|ethic|against the instructions|not allowed|forbidden')
c=0
for l in open('diffs.jsonl'):
    d=json.loads(l); t='\n'.join(d['added'])
    m=pat2.search(t)
    if m: c+=1; print('PERM',d['line'],t[max(0,m.start()-100):m.end()+100].replace('\n',' | '))
print('permission/honesty matches', c)
EOF
